from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
workday=repo/'adapters/workday.py'
tests=repo/'tests/test_workday_adapter.py'
fixture=repo/'tests/fixtures/workday/auth_on_autofill_route.html'
source=tests.read_text()
old='''async def test_autofill_choice_clicks_before_upload_fields_exist(monkeypatch):
    page = FakeFormPage()
    context = WorkdayApplicationContext(
'''
new='''async def test_autofill_choice_clicks_before_upload_fields_exist(monkeypatch):
    page = FakeFormPage()
    page.url = WORKDAY_URL + "/autofillWithResume"
    context = WorkdayApplicationContext(
'''
if source.count(old)!=1:
    raise SystemExit(f'Unexpected original test fixture state: {source.count(old)}')
if 'refreshed_stage = detect_workday_stage(' not in workday.read_text() or not fixture.is_file():
    raise SystemExit('Prior hydration guard changes missing')
tests.write_text(source.replace(old,new,1))
cmd=[str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_workday_adapter.py','tests/test_foundation_policy.py','tests/test_profile_store.py','tests/test_jobctl.py','tests/test_jobpipe_autopilot.py','tests/test_jobpipe_readiness.py']
r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=180)
print(r.stdout[-12000:])
print(r.stderr[-2000:])
if r.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','adapters/workday.py','tests/test_workday_adapter.py','tests/fixtures/workday/auth_on_autofill_route.html'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','fix: reclassify Workday stage after SPA hydration'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','origin','main'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=90)
print('HYDRATION_GUARD_PUSH_VERIFIED')
